name: VFD Group
source: CRON 20261014: VFD Group Plc consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income for the period ended 30 June 2026, Group column 30 June 2026 (NGX doclib filing library), thousands of naira scaled to naira. Net revenue less total expenses equals the printed operating profit before income tax exactly; the printed operating profit less finance cost plus the printed share of profit from associate equals the printed profit before income tax, and less the printed taxation equals the printed profit for the period. The panel has no row for share of profit from associate, so the printed finance cost is stored as Net Finance Costs and Profit Before Tax is the printed figure. EPS in naira per share from the printed kobo figure. | NGX (doclib.ngxgroup.com) | blank split cells computed from the file's own stored totals (Gross Profit = Revenue - Cost of Sales; the current/non-current split sums to the total) | CRON 20261011_193000: Net Finance Costs filled from the issuer's own audited annual report, Consolidated and Separate Statements of Profit or Loss and Other Comprehensive Income page 29 (N thousands, Group column): Finance Cost note 5.1 (38,203,822) for 2025 and (35,413,339) for 2024. Stored as absolute naira with the printed expense sign. 2025 less 2024 finance cost reconciles the printed operating profit before income tax 52,247,286 to the stored Profit Before Tax 14,175,614 within the other printed lines.

rows.label: EPS

unitGuard.reason: Withheld: the EPS row reads -0.431937 for FY2023, the OPPOSITE sign to the net profit reported for the same period (2.53079e+08), and its magnitude is 21.62x that period's net profit divided by the shares on file (0.019977) - a figure of a different order, not a share-count basis difference. The inputs on file do not recover the printed per-share figure, so nothing is published for this period. A blank is honest; a per-share figure whose sign contradicts its own period's earnings is not.

rows.unitGuardBasis: factor = stored EPS / (the same period's net profit / shares on file); a factor within 15% of a power of ten (or its reciprocal) whose corrected value lands within 2.0x of the triangle is a UNIT error and is normalised; a stored cell of the opposite sign to the period's net profit whose magnitude is beyond 5.0x is WITHHELD with both figures named; every other cell is left exactly as filed
